'''January 2001 Smyrna tournament (20 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Champions', Smyrna, Georgia on 20 January 2001. [[John Digiovanni]] won it. It is known from John Digiovanni's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1647">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-20-smyrna-georgia-1-20-2001d1647/ smyrna-georgia-1-20-2001], DeckTech (John "Parn12" Digiovanni, 20 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-20-smyrna-georgia-1-20-2001d1647/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Champions', Smyrna, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[John Digiovanni]]
